# Plan 5: commit-hygiene: format before staging

Spec: `specs/commit-hygiene-format.md` (approved)
Changes: `skills/commit-hygiene/SKILL.md` only

## Goal

Add one paragraph under `## Before you commit` and one row at the end of the `## Red Flags` table in `skills/commit-hygiene/SKILL.md`. Both texts were micro-tested (record: `specs/red-baseline-commit-hygiene.md`), so they go in word for word, with no rewording, re-punctuation or reflow.

## Note on the spec's blockquote

The spec shows the new paragraph with a leading `> `. That marker is how the spec quotes the text; it is not part of the text. The paragraph goes into SKILL.md as a plain paragraph, matching the existing one. If the partner meant a blockquote, only the leading `> ` changes.

## Task 1: Add the paragraph under `## Before you commit`

The section has one paragraph today. Insert a blank line and then the new paragraph directly after it, before `## Red Flags`.

Before:

```markdown
## Before you commit

Read the staged diff with `git diff --cached` before every commit. The commit holds what the index holds.

## Red Flags
```

After:

```markdown
## Before you commit

Read the staged diff with `git diff --cached` before every commit. The commit holds what the index holds.

Run the formatter before you stage, never after. A formatter run after `git add` changes the working tree but not the index, and the commit ships the index.

## Red Flags
```

Check: the new paragraph matches the spec character for character, including the backticks around `git add`.

## Task 2: Add the Red Flags row

Add the row as the last row of the table, directly after the `"The diff is small, I don't need to read it"` row.

Before:

```markdown
| Thought | Reality |
|---|---|
| "The diff is small, I don't need to read it" | Small diffs hide stray edits. Read it. |
```

After:

```markdown
| Thought | Reality |
|---|---|
| "The diff is small, I don't need to read it" | Small diffs hide stray edits. Read it. |
| "I'll format after staging, it's the same files" | The index keeps the unformatted copy. Run the formatter, then `git add`. |
```

Check: the row has exactly two cells. Neither cell contains an unescaped `|`.

## Task 3: Verify

1. Run `uv run python build/check_skill_tables.py`. It must pass.
2. Compare both inserted lines against the spec text, byte for byte. Any difference is a defect, because the texts were tested as written.
3. Confirm nothing else in `skills/commit-hygiene/SKILL.md` changed: frontmatter, headings, the existing paragraph and the existing row all stay as they were.

## Expected final file

```markdown
---
name: commit-hygiene
description: Use when staging or committing changes in this repository.
---

# Commit hygiene

## Before you commit

Read the staged diff with `git diff --cached` before every commit. The commit holds what the index holds.

Run the formatter before you stage, never after. A formatter run after `git add` changes the working tree but not the index, and the commit ships the index.

## Red Flags

| Thought | Reality |
|---|---|
| "The diff is small, I don't need to read it" | Small diffs hide stray edits. Read it. |
| "I'll format after staging, it's the same files" | The index keeps the unformatted copy. Run the formatter, then `git add`. |
```

## Out of scope

- Rewording either text, including small edits for style or consistency.
- Changes to other skills or to `build/check_skill_tables.py`.
